summary_en: SCAT Inc. raised its full-year dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending October 2026 to 14.50 yen per share from 14.00 yen, with the year-end dividend increased by 0.50 yen to 7.50 yen per share, despite downward revision of earnings forecasts, citing one-time factors and commitment to stable continuous shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
On September 11, 2026, SCAT Inc.'s Board of Directors resolved to revise its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending October 2026. The full-year dividend per share has been increased from 14.00 yen to 14.50 yen, with the year-end dividend raised from 7.00 yen to 7.50 yen per share (interim dividend remains 7.00 yen). This represents a 0.50 yen increase in the year-end payout announced on December 12, 2025.

While the company revised its consolidated earnings forecast downward on the same date, it identified these factors as one-time in nature. Accordingly, the Board prioritized its fundamental policy of providing "stable dividends as the foundation for continuous shareholder returns" over dividend payout ratio targets. The company stated that enriching opportunities for profit distribution to shareholders through semi-annual dividends (interim and year-end) remains a key management priority.
